EARLY WRITING & PENCIL CONTROL WORKSHEETS

Early Writing & Pencil Control worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Tracing guides, mazes and dot-to-dots — the exact strokes the Writing Adventures trace on screen. Every sheet twins with a real game in Early Writing & Pencil Control (Class 27) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Hedgehog’s Winding Path Age 4Class 27Writing A long winding road from hedgehog to strawberry — trace it, then try it smaller, then draw it yourself. View Worksheet → Busy Bee Loop Practice Age 4Class 27Writing Four connected loops carry the bee to the flowers — the same movement cursive will ask for later. View Worksheet → Sailboat Wave Tracing Age 4Class 27Writing Three calm waves carry the boat to the lighthouse — up, down, up, down, all the way there. View Worksheet → Rocket Zigzag Mission Age 4Class 27Writing A sharp zigzag flight from rocket to planet — crisp corners are the mission. View Worksheet → Snail Spiral Drawing Age 4Class 27Writing A spiral from the middle outwards — round and round, each circle a little bigger. View Worksheet → Rainbow Arch Tracing Age 4Class 27Writing Four big rainbow arches to trace — the giant shoulder movement every writer needs first. View Worksheet → Spider Web Builder Age 4Class 27Writing Sixteen straight spokes make the spider’s web — short, careful lines from edge to center. View Worksheet → Puppy Maze Adventure Age 4Class 27Writing A real maze with real walls: find the puppy’s path to the bone without crossing any line. View Worksheet → Ladybug Dot-to-Dot Age 4Class 27Writing Ten numbered dots around the ladybug’s back — connect 1 to 10 and watch the shell appear. View Worksheet → Safari Line Drawing Age 4Class 27Writing Twelve safari strokes — vertical, horizontal and diagonal lines that build the whole alphabet’s skeleton. View Worksheet → Octopus Curly Arms Age 4Class 27Writing Six curly arms that curl inward — the trickiest curves in the ocean, traced one arm at a time. View Worksheet → Pencil Stroke Academy Age 4Class 27Writing The four handwriting strokes in one academy class: tall down, flat across, the circle and the zigzag. View Worksheet → Castle Bridge Builder Age 4Class 27Writing Five flat bridges to build for the castle — straight horizontal lines, each one doing a job. View Worksheet → Lion’s Crazy Mane Age 4Class 27Writing Twelve strokes burst outward from the lion’s face — a mane made of confident radiating lines. View Worksheet → Rainy Day Drawing Age 4Class 27Writing Rain falls in short, long and slanted strokes — nine raindrops of pencil practice. View Worksheet → Dinosaur Fossil Artist Age 4Class 27Writing Careful outline tracing around a dinosaur fossil — precision work for careful hands. View Worksheet → Teddy Bear Stitching Studio Age 4Class 27Writing Twelve numbered dots stitch the teddy together — connect them in order and bring the bear to life. View Worksheet → Penguin Figure-Eight Skating Age 4Class 27Writing A figure eight on the ice — one continuous loop that crosses itself once, just like real skaters. View Worksheet → Little Railway Engineer Age 4Class 27Writing Two long railway tracks to trace — parallel lines that stay friends the whole way. View Worksheet → Mountain Tent Builder Age 4Class 27Writing Six diagonal strokes pitch the tent — slanted lines meeting at peaks, one side at a time. View Worksheet → Duckling Bridge Arches Age 4Class 27Writing Three little arches carry the ducklings over the pond — semicircles up and over, one bridge at a time. View Worksheet → Robot Circuit Workshop Age 4Class 27Writing Robot circuits with right-angle turns — sharp corners, straight lines, zero wobble allowed. View Worksheet → Butterfly Mirror Drawing Age 4Class 27Writing Trace one wing, mirror the other — symmetry made with pencil strokes instead of colors. View Worksheet → Fluffy Sheep Wool Artist Age 4Class 27Writing Connected bumps make the sheep’s wool — hump after hump, all the way around. View Worksheet → Giraffe Necklace Designer Age 4Class 27Writing Five beads for the giraffe’s necklace — full circles, drawn all the way round and closed. View Worksheet → Castle Brick Artist Age 4Class 27Writing Rectangles make the castle wall — six bricks, four corners each, every brick a little building. View Worksheet → Squirrel Acorn Drawing Age 4Class 27Writing Four acorns of ovals — smooth rounded shapes, plump in the middle, gentle at the ends. View Worksheet → Pinwheel Shape Maker Age 4Class 27Writing Four triangles spin the pinwheel — three straight sides and three corners, times four. View Worksheet → Crab Claw Curves Age 4Class 27Writing Two big open curves snap like crab claws — the letter C’s shape, with a pinch of attitude. View Worksheet → Sunshine Stroke Challenge Age 4Class 27Writing The grand finale: twelve mixed rays of sunshine — every stroke your child has learned, in one bright page. View Worksheet →
